title: Evènements de présence par jour (selected month)

data.url: http://fhome.frett27.internal:3000/sql/select date_trunc('day', arrow_cast(timestamp,'Timestamp(Microsecond,None)')) as day, count(*) as event_count from mqtt_hive where topic='home%2Fesp13%2Fsensors%2Fpresence' and year={{YEAR}} and month={{MONTH}} group by date_trunc('day', arrow_cast(timestamp,'Timestamp(Microsecond,None)')) order by day
